name: Secret Ingredients Check
description: Scans every script under scripts/ for get_secret(...) calls (Python) and secrets_store.py get <product> <key> calls (Lua/bash shelling out), then cross-checks each referenced product/key against what's actually set in the Secrets Store - flagging any secret a script expects that isn't configured yet, visible before that script fails on it at runtime. Also lists secrets that are set but never referenced by any script found. Best-effort static scan (regex over file contents, not a real parser) - it cannot resolve a product/key built from a variable at runtime, so results are a floor on real issues, not an exhaustive guarantee. Mirrors MOTD's own Script Ingredients Check pattern, applied to secrets instead of missing files.
